calls.reason: ABC's timeline shows OpenAI learned of the breach on Aug 11 and didn't mention it when Altman met Marles on Sept 1. It only emailed a researcher inbox on Sept 10, the PM made it public on Sept 24, and OpenAI's statement came after that.

The researchers' site suggests OpenAI staff knew by June 21 and had made no public disclosure by Sept 4. The packet has no record of whether OpenAI privately told the site operators or any authority, so 'told nobody' can't be judged.
